mintAuthority.summary: GHSm remains a reserve-backed Mento V2 FX token issued through the USDm/GHSm Broker pool, not a borrower-specific V3 CDP. Its token and Broker are mutable under the Mento Timelock's two-day delay. The token also authorizes the Celo Validators address; its GHSm-specific issuance reach remains unresolved. D14: issuance is economically unbounded because the token owner can set an arbitrary Broker/minter with no token-level collateral check; the two-day delay does not bound the amount. D29 is not certified because the authorized Validators proxy has separate Celo Governance upgrade authority.

controls.label: Mento Broker (GHSm FX-pool minter)
controls.capDescription: The USDm/GHSm Broker pool issues against swaps and is subject to governance-configured trading limits and breaker checks; no borrower-specific USDm CDP is involved. The Broker cannot be treated as immutable: its proxy owner and implementation are separately mutable.

sources.label: MGP-18: GHSm stays on its Mento V2 USDm FX pool

controls.evidence: At Celo block 78936852, GHSm.broker() returned this Broker; a zero-amount mint eth_call from the Broker succeeded, while the previously authored BorrowerOperations caller reverted with StableTokenV2: not allowed to mint. Broker._getImplementation() returned 0x1b78f6acd05e7bcb00f74863bfd8a7c264143e37 and _getOwner()/owner() returned the Mento Timelock. Verified Broker transferOut() calls StableTokenV2.mint for reserve-recognized stable assets.

controls.label: Mento Timelock (GHSm token owner)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78936852, GHSm.owner() and its EIP-1967 admin slot both resolved to this Timelock; getMinDelay() returned 172800. GHSm's implementation remained 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e. The Broker proxy _getOwner() also returned this Timelock. StableTokenV2 owner-only setBroker/setValidators/setExchange functions can change token minters. Historical July proposer/executor observations are not re-asserted as current membership.

controls.label: Celo Validators (GHSm-authorized mint address)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 78936852, GHSm.validators() returned this address. StableTokenV2 onlyMinter admits broker, validators or exchange; exchange() was zero. Validators._getImplementation() returned 0x13b0b89f3242f815c1fc6c9cf56e1ab5aea4dc58 and _getOwner() returned 0xd533ca259b330c7a88f74e000a3faea2d63b7972. Its verified mintStableToEpochManager path targets getStableToken(). registry() returned 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000ce10, whose getAddressForString("StableToken") returned USDm at 0x765de816845861e75a25fca122bb6898b8b1282a, not GHSm. This observed path does not establish current direct GHSm issuance; governance could still retarget or replace the configured implementation.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-01 at Celo block 78936852. MGP-18 and the live token confirm GHSm remains on its V2 Broker FX pool; the previously authored BorrowerOperations is not authorized to mint GHSm. The token implementation/admin and enforced 172800-second Timelock delay were re-pinned. The Broker proxy is also owned by the Timelock, while the Validators address has a separate observed proxy owner. Its GHSm-specific issuance reach is left as a scoped question rather than assumed safe. D14/D29 review 2026-10-03 at Celo block 79142378 (hash 0xe5ac3917c420c5f097992356e3a8934c336d354a139b8a1207fe547af3569c6c): owner(), _getOwner(), and the EIP-1967 admin slot resolve to Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147, not the migration Safe; the implementation slot resolves to verified StableTokenV2 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e. Read-only setBroker(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead) from that owner succeeds, and mint(chosenRecipient,1e18) from the configured Broker succeeds. Verified setBroker accepts an arbitrary address; onlyMinter gates mint by caller identity and imposes no collateral/deposit check or economic ceiling. The 172800-second Timelock delay does not make arbitrary minter authorization economically bounded. D29 screening confirms MentoGovernor proposer/canceller membership, open execution, Timelock administration, and no such Safe roles; the separately observed canceller 0xe6951c4176aab41097c6f5fe11e9c515b7108acd is not asserted to have mint power. The governor uses the verified lock-escrowed veMENTO contract. However validators() on this token resolves to 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, whose proxy owner is separate Celo Governance 0xd533ca259b330c7a88f74e000a3faea2d63b7972: independently replacing this token-authorized implementation is not rooted in MentoGovernor. Current Validators targets registry USDm, not this token; that observation does not close its independent upgrade path. Complete governor-only issuance closure is therefore not certified and no governedIssuance or complete executionScope is authored. This D14 verdict supersedes any earlier raiseable/partially-bounded economic inference; reconciliation and supervision are unchanged.

scopedQuestions.question: What governance and authorization path can replace the Validators implementation or retarget its registry-selected stable token from the currently observed USDm to GHSm?
